description: Performance for ChatGPT Ads: impressions, clicks, spend, CTR, CPC, CPM; CONVERSIONS with CPA, post-click conversion rate and attributed order sales / ROAS; and REACH by default (reach = unique people, frequency, click reach / frequency, total reach / frequency, unique CTR, unique CPC, cost per 1,000 reached). totals.reach is OpenAI’s de-duplicated number for the whole window, never a sum of rows. OpenAI returns conversions only with granularity none or daily and no segment or a country/device one, CPA, conversion rate and sales only with no segment, and reach with any segment but product; the note names any column OpenAI left out (their limit, not a zero). Since OpenAI’s 2026-09-30 change conversions count click-through PLUS view-through goal conversions within the reporting windows (default 30-day click, 1-day view, by ad interaction time); CPA uses them, post-click conversion rate click-through only. clickWindowDays (7, 14, 30), viewWindowDays (0 = clicks only, or 1) and attributionTimeBasis set those windows for this report only; the reply’s `attribution` names them. Scope: none = the whole ad account, or campaignId / adGroupId / adId. PRODUCT-FEED CAROUSEL ads also report per card: ask in `fields` for carousel_product_card_impressions / _clicks and the product_* fields (impressions, clicks, spend, ctr, cpc, cpm, title, price, feed_id); they come back under each row’s `fields`. A card impression is NOT billable; never add it to spend math. granularity hourly, daily, monthly or none (default daily); default window the last 30 days; segment by country, device or platform; level rolls rows up by campaign / ad group / ad. NO rows means NO delivery in that window; never present zeros as measured performance. attributedEvents:true adds every event OpenAI attributed beyond the campaign goal (purchases on a sign-up campaign) for the same scope and days; never add those counts to conversions. Read-only and free: run it FIRST after connecting to prove the key works.

adGroupId.description: scope the report to one ad group

adId.description: scope the report to one ad

after.description: nextAfter from the previous page; limit goes up to 2000 rows

attributedEvents.description: add events attributed beyond the goal

campaignId.description: scope the report to one campaign; omit for the whole ad account

conversions.description: default true: add conversions, CPA, conversion rate and sales where OpenAI allows them. false leaves them out.

fields.description: extra insight fields by name, e.g. product_title, product_price, carousel_product_card_impressions; each row returns them under `fields`

filters.description: keep only matching rows, e.g. {field:"campaign.status",operator:"IN",value:["active"]} or {field:"ad.clicks",operator:"GREATER_THAN",value:100}

field.description: field to filter on, e.g. campaign.status or ad.clicks

operator.description: IN matches a list; GREATER_THAN and LESS_THAN compare a number

value.description: list of values for IN; a number for GREATER_THAN or LESS_THAN

includeZeroImpressions.description: also list campaigns / ad groups / ads with no impressions (unsegmented reports only)

level.description: roll rows up to this level

reach.description: default true: add reach, frequency, click reach / frequency, total reach / frequency, unique CTR, unique CPC and cost per 1,000 reached (not with segment product). false leaves them out.

segment.description: extra group-by dimension (at most one). platform splits rows by ChatGPT app or browser (ios_app, android_app, desktop_web, ios_web, android_web, and web for rows from before 2026-09-10, which OpenAI does not split retroactively); it reports delivery metrics only, not conversions

field.description: field to order rows by, e.g. campaign.spend

name: openai_ads_report
title: ChatGPT Ads performance report
